plain_description.what: Fits flat k-means separately at a coarse and at a fine number of clusters and measures how often a fine cluster spreads over several coarse clusters; the tree is nested by construction. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: If separate flat clusterings at each size do not nest, they cannot replace a tree as a hierarchy without extra reconciliation.
plain_description.information: Shows how far separately fitted flat clusterings fail to form a hierarchy. Result: done. They do not nest: in every case 38% to 66% of items sit in fine clusters that are split across coarse clusters, so 'flat k-means at every level' cannot replace a tree without a reconciliation step.
